races.name: Auto Services Perth Supporting Dundee Bairns Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
DUNKERQUE has thrived switched to fences this summer and has been found another excellent opportunity to add to his tally, though potential improver Follow Your Luck should make a good race of it.

  1. DUNKERQUE (DEN)
  2. FOLLOW YOUR LUCK (IRE)

races.name: Auto Services Volkswagen Commercial Aftersales Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
COSMOS D'AINAY sets a clear standard after his dominant win at Cork so he should prove hard to beat. Fellow-penalised winner Puppet Master can make it a 1-2 for the Irish.

  1. COSMOS D'AINAY (FR)
  2. PUPPET MASTER (IRE)
  3. DATSTHEHOLYALLOFIT (IRE)

races.name: Auto Services Perth 24-Hour Recovery Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
CASTLEHEATH isn't the most straightforward but he was unlucky to bump into one at the Galway Festival on his comeback 5 weeks ago and a repeat of that effort would give him every chance. Pure Gold and Just Dottie both have good records here and they head the dangers.

  1. CASTLEHEATH (IRE)
  2. PURE GOLD
  3. JUST DOTTIE

races.name: Auto Services Mercedes Benz Truck Aftersales Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
REGAL RENAISSANCE is enjoying a good summer and can swiftly resume winning ways with her latest Worcester effort looking strong form. No Regrets will be a player if picking up where he left off in the spring, with Wasdell Dundalk making most appeal of the remaining trio.

  1. REGAL RENAISSANCE
  2. NO REGRETS (IRE)
  3. WASDELL DUNDALK (FR)

races.name: www.asp.scot Stellantis Commercial Aftersales Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
FOLLOW CHARLIE can complete the hat-trick at the chief expense of Annie Agnew, who pulled clear with him over C&D 3 weeks ago. Lowlands is still reasonably low mileage in handicaps and should find the drop in trip to his benefit.

  1. FOLLOW CHARLIE (IRE)
  2. ANNIE AGNEW
  3. LOWLANDS (IRE)

races.name: Auto Services Perth Sales And Rentals Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
DOWN AROUND benefited from the step up to a staying trip at Ballinrobe and can double his tally for Gordon Elliott now returned to a staying trip. Theirshegoes went best for a long way at Uttoxeter last time and is respected with that form having been franked, whilst C'Mon So is still lightly raced in handicaps and could have more to offer.

  1. DOWN AROUND (IRE)
  2. THEIRSHEGOES (IRE)
  3. C'MON SO (IRE)

races.name: Sky Sports Racing Juvenile Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
MOMENT OF LIGHT was the best of these on the Flat, has joined a leading NH yard and gets 7 lb from previous winners Timely Salute and Hello Garda, so hopes are high that he will make a winning debut in this sphere.

  1. MOMENT OF LIGHT
  2. TIMELY SALUTE
  3. HELLO GARDA (IRE)

races.name: Race Against Waste Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
This sharp test will suit EXPLODE, who should have plenty more to offer in this sphere given his Flat ability. He is therefore marginally preferred to Crystal Mariner and Crackalackin.

  1. EXPLODE (FR)
  2. CRYSTAL MARINER (IRE)
  3. CRACKALACKIN (IRE)

races.name: St. Austell Brewery Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
SAINT POLO has completed a hat-trick over hurdles fitted with a tongue strap since his underwhelming chase debut and he's well worth another chance over the larger obstacles. Miss Denver arrives in excellent order and looks the obvious threat.

  1. SAINT POLO (FR)
  2. MISS DENVER
  3. JUGGERNAUT (FR)

races.name: Devonport Royal Dockyard Social Club Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
MY GIRL KATIE has been prolific in the last year or so and a 4 lb rise for her recent C&D win looks within range. Fairlawn Skipper and Masterdream head the opposition.

  1. MY GIRL KATIE (IRE)
  2. FAIRLAWN SKIPPER
  3. MASTERDREAM (FR)

races.name: Par Inn Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
EDELAK has built up a fine record front-running in small-field events and may well be able to take advantage of a similar scenario here. Arctic Voyage appeals most for forecast purposes.

  1. EDELAK (IRE)
  2. ARCTIC VOYAGE
  3. ELLERTON (FR)

races.name: Grandad Swales Happy 80th Birthday Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
MR MCWHINNY has been rejuvenated since switching yards and makes most appeal to quickly regain the winning thread from Jetty May, who shaped better than the result on chasing debut and should yet have more to offer in this sphere.

  1. MR MCWHINNY (IRE)
  2. JETTY MAY (IRE)
  3. HATOS (FR)

races.name: Sun Racing Summer Jumps Championship Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
The form of MOTHER SHIP's Sligo run has been franked and she can go one better here at the expense of Ocean Heights, who should appreciate this longer trip. Captain Connor appeals best of the rest for place purposes.

  1. MOTHER SHIP (IRE)
  2. OCEAN HEIGHTS
  3. CAPTAIN CONNOR (FR)

races.name: Free Bets On attheraces.com EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
ROXA LOVE is the percentage call on the back of her win when last seen but a market move for Richard Hughes newcomer Kerry Grey would make her a potential big threat, with the booking of Billy Loughnane taking the eye.

  1. ROXA LOVE
  2. KERRY GREY
  3. ROGUE DAKOTA (IRE)

races.name: Cavani Sartorial Nursery
races.verdict:
LAURALYNN has bumped into some well-treated rivals when placed in both her nurseries and looks sure to go well. Lady of Hay has the potential for improvement now venturing into handicaps and is second choice ahead of Crystal Kraken.

  1. LAURALYNN (IRE)
  2. LADY OF HAY
  3. CRYSTAL KRAKEN

races.name: Free Bets On attheraces.com Restricted Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
This looks a good opportunity for PON PON DALIA to make it third time lucky, with the drop to 6f unlikely to inconvenience the way she went about things over 7f here last time. Langdale Lass looks the obvious threat if bouncing back to the level of her debut second.

  1. PON PON DALIA (IRE)
  2. LANGDALE LASS
  3. FALAH GLORY (IRE)

races.name: Follow AtTheRaces On Instagram Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
All 4 have claims but this might be another small-field affair BRUNHILDE can control from the front and she's preferred to Level Look, who has shaped better than the result in all 3 handicaps.

  1. BRUNHILDE (IRE)
  2. LEVEL LOOK
  3. LAST VERSE (IRE)

races.name: Call 01902 390016 To Name A Race Handicap
races.verdict:
If TEN SIXTY SIX is in the same form as when narrowly denied at Ripon last Monday she may prove the answer to this 3-y-o handicap. Billy Loughnane's mount Miss Mambo is another who went close last time and she's second choice ahead of Ernie McCrew, who should benefit from the slight drop back in trip.

  1. TEN SIXTY SIX (IRE)
  2. MISS MAMBO (IRE)
  3. ERNIE MCCREW (IRE)

races.name: Cavani Signature Style Handicap
races.verdict:
Preference is for MIDNIGHT MEDIA, who is thriving at present and was unlucky not to make it 3 wins from her last 4 starts over C&D last week. She can make amends at the expense of Evening Fades, who finished runner-up here on penultimate start and now first-time cheekpieces are applied. The Anthony Gover can edge out Snaafy for minor honours.

  1. MIDNIGHT MEDIA
  2. EVENING FADES
  3. THE ANTHONY GOVER

races.name: attheraces.com/marketmovers Handicap
races.verdict:
Cases can be made for several of these but the most persuasive is for COMMANDER OF LIFE, who was value extra when regaining the winning thread at Doncaster in July and Jessica Macey's 5-y-o can make light of a subsequent 5 lb rise in the weights. His main threat may emerge from Knights Gold, who won at Brighton recently and should benefit from this return to further. Londoner edges the vote over stablemate Helm Rock for third.

  1. COMMANDER OF LIFE (IRE)
  2. KNIGHTS GOLD (IRE)
  3. LONDONER (IRE)

races.name: Get The Inside Track With raceday-ready.com Handicap
races.verdict:
FIORELLA PRINCESS went mightily close to making a perfect start for new connections at Lingfield last month when bumping into Whizzy Dizzy and on 1 lb better terms with that rival here, Robert Cowell's filly is fancied to turn the tables. Enter Sandman and another last-time-out winner Blue Force can battle out minor honours.

  1. FIORELLA PRINCESS (IRE)
  2. WHIZZY DIZZY (IRE)
  3. ENTER SANDMAN (IRE)

races.name: Matchbook Signup - Get 20% Back On Loses Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
ARNAZ wasn't seen to ideal effect but still emerged with a lot of credit when sixth in a big field at Brighton last time and can quickly bounce back to winning ways here to bag a third success of 2026. Good Earth has slipped to his last winning mark and heads the list of dangers, while Yes Walim, Stock Market and Lahina Bay also need factoring into this very open handicap.

  1. ARNAZ
  2. GOOD EARTH (IRE)
  3. YES WALIIM (IRE)

races.name: Hamish Johnson Memorial EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
The betting should reveal plenty here but it could be worth siding with ROMOTOSO to belatedly confirm debut Doncaster promise and get off the mark with Oisin Murphy now in the saddle. Both Sequel Star and Thai Baht look to have better days ahead of them and can also play a prominent role, while Miss Tango is another to consider in an open novice.

  1. ROMOTOSO
  2. SEQUEL STAR (IRE)
  3. THAI BAHT

races.name: Matchbook Betting Exchange Supporting UK Racing Nursery
races.verdict:
The reliable PAST PASSION is taken to gain a deserved first success having not enjoyed the rub of the green when fourth at Lingfield last time. Devon Angel rates a big threat if backing up her recent Chepstow second, while Courage Best, Wopbopaloomop and Marralyn are all likely capable of better and need factoring into this very open nursery too.

  1. PAST PASSION
  2. DEVON ANGEL
  3. COURAGE BEST (IRE)

races.name: Follow Matchbook On X Handicap
races.verdict:
ECCLEFECHAN hasn't looked back since going up to 1m and is weighted to complete a quick hat-trick racing off a 2 lb lower mark here than when a stylish winner at Yarmouth last week. Ascending Star and Luzon Heights are proving reliable sorts and can fight it out for minor honours.

  1. ECCLEFECHAN
  2. ASCENDING STAR (IRE)
  3. LUZON HEIGHTS

races.name: Weatherbys Global Stallions App Winter Hill Stakes (Group 3)
races.verdict:
A few useful sorts with the potential for better still in an intriguing Group 3 but it's hard to side against RAAHEEB, who lost his unbeaten record when fourth in the Irish Derby but can bounce back to winning ways in style here. Charlie Appleby's Maho Bay appeals as the one to chase him home ahead of Crest of Fire and Morris Dancer.

  1. RAAHEEB (IRE)
  2. MAHO BAY
  3. CREST OF FIRE (IRE)

races.name: G J Colairo Diamond Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
WITHOUT PREJUDICE created an excellent impression when going in at the first time of asking at Newmarket and gets a confident vote to make light of a 7 lb penalty before going on to better things. Ed Walker's Masar newcomer Saaffya could emerge as the one to chase home the Gosdens' highly promising Starman filly ahead of Yamnah and Aura Champagne.

  1. WITHOUT PREJUDICE (IRE)
  2. SAAFFYA
  3. YAMNAH (FR)

races.name: Bet 20 Pound Get 40 Pound In Free Bets At matchbook.com Handicap
races.verdict:
This is wide open but BATED BREEZE rates the pick of the weights and can double his tally now dropped in grade having also been poorly drawn when down the field at Brighton last time. The consistent Washington Heir is next on the list, while Call Time, My Mate Mackley and Roman Spring also need factoring into this very open sprint.

  1. BATED BREEZE (IRE)
  2. WASHINGTON HEIR
  3. CALL TIME (IRE)

races.name: Kenny Developments Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
IT'S TIME FOR A RUN may have been well held in 2 maiden hurdles last winter but the fact he won a bumper for new trainer Emmet Mullins at Downpatrick in July suggests he could prove a totally different proposition now resuming his hurdle career. En Or was a good third when last seen over hurdles and gets the nod for the forecast spot ahead of Wonderful Everyday, who has only managed a pair of fifths in similar races this summer but retains potential for a top stable based on bumper form.

  1. ITS TIME FOR A RUN (IRE)
  2. EN OR (FR)
  3. WONDERFUL EVERYDAY (IRE)

races.name: Anglo Printers Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
EURO MAKER has had the form of his Ballinrobe success boosted by the second winning since so Adrian Murray's 5-y-o could still be well treated off 6 lb higher. Crowsatedappletart probably shouldn't have his latest Cork sixth as evidence that he can't make an impact from his lower hurdle mark. The reliable Inthenickoftime is likely to be in the mix again, while Colin's Friend is one to keep a close eye on in the betting now handicapping for new trainer Henry de Bromhead.

  1. EURO MAKER (IRE)
  2. CROWSATEDAPPLETART (IRE)
  3. INTHENICKOFTIME (IRE)

races.name: Deacy Gilligan Hurdle
races.verdict:
Not the easiest race to assess but it could pay to side with PAUL'S DREAM who can bag a third hurdling success of the season at the chief expense of Grann's Boy who comes here on the back of a career-best victory here last month. Veteran French Dynamite has an absence to overcome but is weighted to go well if ready to roll.

  1. PAUL'S DREAM (IRE)
  2. GRANN'S BOY (IRE)
  3. FRENCH DYNAMITE (FR)

races.name: WTW Willis Handicap Hurdle (0-100) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
JOHN STOREY was strong in the market when taking a big step back in the right direction at Roscommon 5 weeks ago and he remains of interest back in this sphere. Recent Ballinrobe 1-2 Princess Felicia and Joshua Chamberlain head the dangers.

  1. JOHN STOREY (IRE)
  2. PRINCESS FELICIA (IRE)
  3. JOSHUA CHAMBERLAIN (IRE)

races.name: WTW Willis Handicap Hurdle (0-100) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
STRONG CONTENDER has finally put it all together and a 6 lb rise may not be enough to stop her completing the hat-trick. Poetic Focus looks to have found her feet for this yard and should be in the mix, with Tantrum Boy another to consider.

  1. STRONG CONTENDER (IRE)
  2. POETIC FOCUS (IRE)
  3. TANTRUM BOY (IRE)

races.name: Watch Every Irish Race Live On Racing TV Beginners Chase
races.verdict:
OCASTLE DES MOTTES got back on track when second here 38 days ago and can put his experience to good use, though Ndaawi, Daydream Nation and Captain Ryan Matt all look interesting recruits to this sphere.

  1. OCASTLE DES MOTTES (FR)
  2. NDAAWI
  3. DAYDREAM NATION (IRE)

races.name: BOYLE Sports Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
Cases can be made for several of these, and it could pay to take a chance on sole chasing-debutant JUSTATAN, who is bred for this discipline (successful on both starts in points) and upped his game when third over hurdles here at the Festival last month. Smallcraftwarning is only 2 lb higher than when scoring at Kilbeggan on Friday so he's most feared, ahead of Granville Street and Brandt.

  1. JUSTATAN (FR)
  2. SMALLCRAFTWARNING (IRE)
  3. GRANVILLE STREET (IRE)

races.name: Kenny Developments Irish EBF Mares Flat Race
races.verdict:
BRICKFIELD BELLE has shown ability both over hurdles and in a bumper and is fancied to make a winning return from almost 6 months off. Streamhill has a solid record in bumpers and can make the placings, while Lake Pippaway was better than the result on her debut and can progress.

  1. BRICKFIELD BELLE (IRE)
  2. STREAMHILL (IRE)
  3. LAKE PIPPAWAY (IRE)
